newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate unchanged at 5.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate unchanged at 5.74 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was unchanged for the third week running at 5.74 percent, a spokeswoman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price was also unchanged at 98.570 while the minimum price accepted fell to 98.552 from 98.565.
Banks submitted bids for 31.4 million dinars worth of bills, up from 23 million dinars last week.
Maturing on October 1, the bills were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
